name: IGFP 5302
title: Advanced Practice with Individuals, Groups and Families: Theoretical Approaches
description: Overview of theoretical approaches to working with individuals, groups and families. Helps students to think critically about the use of theory in practice, evidence based practice, and ways of learning and knowing, including use of supervision. Introduction to psychodynamic, attachment, cognitive, and behavioral, as well as solution-focused approaches and motivational interviewing. The stages of group development, group dynamics and other content related to social work practice with groups. Theoretical frameworks such as systems, multisystemic and attachment on which family practice approaches are based.
requirement_description: IGFP 5301; open only to MSW students in the Individuals, Groups and Families concentration. Corequisite: IGFP 5353 and FED 5310, or IGFP 5355.
